OptionGroup.SupportedMod: Currently Supported Mods for Mod Settings Backup
Option.ShowNotif.Label: Show Notification
Option.PlaySound.Label: Play Sound
Option.PlaySound.Desc: Play a small audio sound on mods loading completed.
Option.AutoSaveOffChirp.Label: Show chirp about autosave disabled
Option.AutoSaveOffChirp.Desc:
Show chirp message every minute to remind that autosave is off.
Requires <Custom Chirps> mod.
Option.DisableContinueOnLauncher.Label: Disable "Resume" button on the Paradox Launcher?
Option.DisableContinueOnLauncher.Desc: Disable showing the "Resume" button on the Paradox Launcher, so it's not clicked accidentally.
Option.DisableContinueInGame.Label: Disable "Continue Game" button on the Main Menu?
Option.DisableContinueInGame.Desc: Disable showing the "Continue Game" button on the Main Menu, so it's not clicked accidentally.
Option.DeleteCorrupted.Label: Auto delete Corrupted Settings
Option.DeleteCorrupted.Desc: Enable the automatic deletion of corrupted settings (game or mod).
Option.AutoRestoreSettingBackupOnStartup: Enable the automatic restoring of all game settings, supported mods settings and all keybinds from Profile 1 when the game starts.
Option.AutoCleanUpOldVersions.Label: Auto Cleanup playsets on startup?
Option.AutoCleanUpOldVersions.Desc: Enable the automatic cleanup of all game playsets when the game starts.
Option.EnableVerboseLogging.Label: Verbose Logging
Option.EnableVerboseLogging.Desc: Enable detailed logging to catch issues (only to be used for debugging purpose).
Option.ProfileNameX.Label: Profile {X}
Option.SaveProfileName.Label: Save Profile Names
Option.SaveProfileName.Desc: Save Profile Names after typing the entries.
Option.ProfileDropdown.Label: Select Profile
Option.ProfileDropdown.Desc:
Select the profile to be used for the buttons below. Profile 1 will be auto restored on launch if the "Auto Restore Settings on Startup (Profile 1)?" is active.
The profile names can be changed from the "Profile Names" tab.
Option.CreateAllBackup.Label: Backup All
Option.CreateAllBackup.Desc: Backup Game Settings, Mod Settings and Keybinds to the selected profile.
Option.RestoreAllBackup.Label: Restore All
Option.RestoreAllBackup.Desc: Restore Game Settings, Mod Settings and Keybinds from the selected profile.
Option.CreateGameBackup.Label: Backup Game Settings
Option.CreateGameBackup.Desc: Backup Game Settings to the selected profile.
Option.RestoreGameBackup.Label: Restore Game Settings
Option.RestoreGameBackup.Desc: Restore Game Settings from the selected profile.
Option.CreateModBackup.Label: Backup Mod Settings
Option.CreateModBackup.Desc: Backup Mod Settings to the selected profile.
Option.RestoreModBackup.Label: Restore Mod Settings
Option.RestoreModBackup.Desc: Restore Mod Settings from the selected profile.
Option.CreateKeybindsBackup.Label: Backup Keybinds
Option.CreateKeybindsBackup.Desc: Backup Keybinds to the selected profile.
Option.RestoreKeybindsBackup.Label: Restore Keybinds
Option.RestoreKeybindsBackup.Desc: Restore Keybinds from the selected profile.
Option.ModListSortByName.Label: Sort By Mod Name
Option.ModListSortByName.Desc: Sort the loaded mod list by the mod's name (Default). Local mods are excluded from sorting and will always be on top.
Option.ModListSortBySize.Label: Sort By Size
Option.ModListSortBySize.Desc: Sort the loaded mod list by size. Local mods are excluded from sorting and will always be on top.
Option.ModListSortByAuthor.Label: Sort By Author Name
Option.ModListSortByAuthor.Desc: Sort the loaded mod list by the author name. Local mods are excluded from sorting and will always be on top.
Option.ModListSortDirection.Label: Toggle list sort direction
Option.ModListSortDirection.Desc:
Toggle the list's sort direction from ascending to descending and vice versa.
Current state: {SimpleModCheckerPlus.Replacement.SortDetails}
Option.ModFolderDropdown.Label: Select Mod for Verification
Option.ModFolderDropdown.Desc: Select a mod package and to verify only that package.
Option.VerifyMods.Label: All Mods
Option.VerifyMods.Desc: Verify all mods downloaded from PDX Mods and currently stored on disk.{SimpleModCheckerPlus.VerifyMoreText}
Option.VerifyModSelected.Label: Selected Mod
Option.VerifyModSelected.Desc: Verify only the mod package selected above which are downloaded from PDX Mods and currently stored on disk.{SimpleModCheckerPlus.VerifyMoreText}
Option.VerifyModsWithoutRP.Label: All except Region Packs
Option.VerifyModsWithoutRP.Desc: Verify all mods downloaded from PDX Mods and currently stored on disk, but without the large Region Packs.{SimpleModCheckerPlus.VerifyMoreText}
Option.VerifyModsActivePlayset.Label: Active Playset
Option.VerifyModsActivePlayset.Desc: Verify all mods in active playset that is downloaded from PDX Mods and currently stored on disk.{SimpleModCheckerPlus.VerifyMoreText}
Option.VerifyModsCheckMetadataFormat.Des: Check all mod's metadata that is downloaded from PDX Mods and currently stored on disk, to find if they are migrated to valid format.{SimpleModCheckerPlus.VerifyMoreText}
Option.CleanUpOldVersions.Label: Clean Up Old Mod Versions
Option.CleanUpOldVersions.Desc: Clean up all playsets where old versions of mods are still subscribed where a more latest version is available.
Option.ModDatabaseTime.Label: Mod Database Time
Option.ModDatabaseTime.Desc: The time when the current mod database was published.
Option.SupportedModText.Label: {SimpleModCheckerPlus.Replacement.SupportedMods}
Option.SupportedModText.Desc: A list of currently supported mod for settings backup/restore.
Option.ReinitializeModList.Label: Reinitialize Mod List
Option.ReinitializeModList.Desc: Cleanup loaded mod data and reinitialize the mod list.
